release.body:
This release introduces 2 new features and documents 4 changes.

## What's Changed

### 🚀 Features

- **infra:** Boot from a custom AMI, and collapse UserData to configuration ([c156e1d](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/c156e1df2f0fa906016f9098e1628f369b0f87a4))
- **infra:** Build versioned custom AMIs ([49c3f8a](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/49c3f8a5e123f609a9c7c1a92d3b53b1de7b0c02))

### 📚 Documentation

- **architecture:** Hand-authored SVG of the platform as built ([98c27b9](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/98c27b925f0a4cd254a833e70bfa2321cf0dd3f4))
- **architecture:** Add a living "as built" diagram, and mark the rest as snapshots ([c7a96aa](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/c7a96aa85aef5901936e8d8db294ec3340f1b7e2))
- Milestone 4 — optimizing Spot startup with custom AMIs ([e7cd6d5](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/e7cd6d565e1a66fb0991cb28995a5a94d095f6f8))
- **changelog:** Add v0.5.0 [skip ci] ([74d16c4](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/74d16c4211cfd16154fe49b29feea268a8594cac))

### 📦 Build System

- **infra:** The AMI lifecycle, and a drift check for the drain agent ([e99b2e2](https://github.com/teddynted/designing-an-ai-agent-platform-on-aws/commit/e99b2e2f1ba163a5716388f60a2b308588be73d3))

### Contributors

- Teddy Kekana (6 commits)
- github-actions[bot] (1 commit)

repositoryStructure.overview: A standard-go project of 112 files organized into 6 top-level directories (.githooks, .github, cmd, docs, infra, internal), separating entry points, business logic, infrastructure, and documentation.

architecture.overview: An event-driven, AWS-native system built from 4 major components on AWS IAM, AWS Lambda, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon EC2, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. A standard-go project of 112 files organized into 6 top-level directories (.githooks, .github, cmd, docs, infra, internal), separating entry points, business logic, infrastructure, and documentation.

components.name: Domain packages
components.responsibility: Business logic behind small, testable ports

architecture.deploymentTopology: A modular, multi-stack CloudFormation deployment: 13 serverless, 2 compute, 2 storage, and 8 networking resources, with least-privilege IAM (6 roles/policies).
architecture.scalability: Stateless Lambda entry points scale horizontally with request volume.
architecture.reliability: Reliability comes from managed, self-healing Lambda execution.
architecture.security: Security is enforced through least-privilege IAM roles, HMAC-verified webhooks.
insights: The pipeline is fully event-driven: EventBridge Scheduler → Lambda → EC2 start/stop.
It blends serverless ingestion with an on-demand compute host, bounding cost while keeping the front door always available.
44 architecture diagram(s) document the system, aiding onboarding and technical writing.
